meaning: A small window that suddenly appears on top of a web page. It is often an ad or a message.
clues: It is a small box that shows up on your screen.
It appears suddenly by itself, even when you did not click or hover on anything. It covers part of the page you were reading.
Many are ads. Some say something is wrong with your computer and tell you to call a number.
Browsers can block most of them, and you can allow the ones you trust.
It is one word with a hyphen in the middle. The first part starts with P.
assumes: A drop-down menu is a list of choices that opens when you click
A tooltip is a small note that shows when you hover
A scroll bar moves a page up and down

decoys.meaning: A list of choices that opens when you click a button.
A small note that shows when you rest your pointer on something.
The strip along the side of a window that you drag to move up and down.
